note: The only observation kinds the rival may receive. Evidence IDs are e<encounter>.<kind>. The service writes these labels into the prompt itself, so no client text reaches the model. Version 4 counts power uses by cooldown family, never by power or rarity (docs/POWERS_AND_FUSION.md section 6).

kinds.far_share: share of the fight the Surge spent far away
kinds.mid_share: share of the fight at middle range
kinds.near_share: share of the fight the Surge spent close
